_source: UIV-A7 (docs/eras/uiv.md, 'A7. Optical mainframe and the UIV sensor', lines 17, 18 and 22): the GTM assembler steps of the optical mainframe line, the chip nuclear clock and the UIV sensor. Real processes: Feldmann et al. 2021 (phase-change photonic in-memory computing on a crossbar), Zhang et al. 2024 (thorium-229 nuclear clock in a ThF4 thin film).
_how_it_is_used: Read by server_scripts/grindless/uiv/mainframe.js at every server load. Each entry of types.<type>.recipes becomes one gtceu:<type> recipe, id grindless:<type>/<name>.
itemsIn / itemsOut: { id, count, chance? }; fluidsIn / fluidsOut: { id, amount } in mB; kept: items never used up; charge: fluids never used up. eut x duration. Circuit 0 = none (GTM's assembler).

The other rows of the line are appended to older tables (photonics.json foundry c13 and MBE c7, photonics_uev.json hall c4-c6, crystals.json nuclear clock lab c3, alpha_centauri.json pulsar timing c3, the fluorspar kiln's UIV_ROWS).
